items.summary: Anti Money Laundering AIAnnouncementNew minor engine version released for the retail line of business within the v004.011 version line (aml-retail.default.v004.011.202610-000). This version extends support for the major engine version and includes no significant changes compared to the previous minor version.Model ArmorFeatureModel Armor is available in Brazil (southamerica-east1). This regionprovides data residency compliance for at-rest, in-use, and in-transit data withlimited feature support.The southamerica-east1 region supports the following filters:Prompt injection and jailbreak detectionResponsible AISensitive Data ProtectionFor more information, see Locations,Data residency and endpoints, andSupported features by region.SAP on Google CloudAnnouncementABAP SDK for Google Cloud version 1.15 (On-premises or any cloud edition)Version 1.15 of the on-premises or any cloud edition of the ABAP SDK for GoogleCloud is generally available (GA). This version enhances binary data handling tolet you download archived .msg files and other binary formats without applyingcharacter decoding when you use Cloud Storage as a content repository for SAP.For more information, seeWhat's new with the on-premises or any cloud edition of the ABAP SDK for Google Cloud.
